sources.floor_rules: backend/app/services/rooms.py (FPM LactationRoom / MenstrualProductDispenser room-floor pairs; USC Libraries Leavey tour guide for LVL)

floor_convention: floor is an ordinal level: 1, 2, 3... = numbered floors (1 = first floor); 0 = a G/GDN level below floor 1; -1 = B/LL/LG (basement, lower level); -2 = SB. floor_label is the building's own label. floor_confidence: exact (documented per-room fact), rule (USC numbering: NXX/NXXX -> floor N, letter prefix -> level), unknown (floor null). building.floors = [-1 if FPM HasBasement] + 1..FPM BldgFlrInt.
pathing: true only for UPC rooms with a known floor (indoor pathing supports UPC only)
